description: Rank live heartbeat-verified MCP and A2A endpoints using 64-bit MGLE-NNP bitwise capability masks and return either a provider-diverse shortlist or a 3-agent complementary crew (Compute + Domain + Verifier) with single-use execution tickets. Use when selecting callable agents for a task; use search_agent_directory for raw keyword browsing or get_agent_dossier when you already have an agent_id.

caller_region.description: Caller geographic zone for round-trip latency affinity ('E' US-East, 'W' US-West, 'U' Europe, 'P' APAC, 'GLOBAL' any).

capabilities.description: Optional explicit MGLE-NNP capability switch names (e.g. sql, database, finance_data, file_parse, math_verify, code_exec, web_fetch, search_rag).

items.description: Canonical capability switch identifier from Bits 0..23.

intent.description: Natural-language task intent used to infer required 64-bit capability switches when capabilities is omitted.

max_latency_grade.description: Worst acceptable Virginia Scout RTT grade ('A' <=120ms, 'B' <=300ms, 'C' <=700ms default, 'D' <=1500ms, 'ANY' unrestricted live RTT).

mode.description: Routing policy: 'top10_varied' for ranked shortlist across distinct vendors, or 'crew' for a 3-role complementary triad.

require_instant_zero_auth.description: True restricts results strictly to open zero-credential endpoints callable immediately without API keys or OAuth.

top_k.description: Maximum number of ranked candidates to return (1..25, default 10).

name: matchmake_agent_crew

finalists.description: Ranked candidate agent records including endpoint URL, 64-bit hex ID, and execution_ticket.

title: Matchmake 64-Bit Agent Shortlist or 3-Agent Crew
